dollar_stop.applied: **KILL.** For some asset, both primary variants miss the full dollar block at every qualifying age, or no single variant carries all three assets. The frozen observable-record family closes at late ages on era labels, by receipt. A miss on the pre-stated bar is a KILL, not a near-miss, including a rung cleared with MDD above 1000. The per-age curves, the decomposition lines, and `side_agreement` hand the gap's shape to the next covering, which decides fitted-or-dead against those numbers. Nothing is auto-funded: no fitted picker, no training-scale relabel, no third read, no new variant.

verbatim.LIVE: **LIVE.** One pre-named variant, the same for all three assets, posts the full dollar block at some qualifying age per asset, caps and overlap holding, MDD at most 1000, on the locked denominators. A causal entry rule on the stored-teacher exit law pays every rung on era labels. Teacher-cash cannot promote, so nothing ships from a LIVE. The successor questions are the exit leg, whose law is stored hindsight, and validation scale, authorized by the next covering, which also owns the training-scale relabel priced against this receipt. Nothing else is funded.
verbatim.STOP: **STOP, infrastructure.** The selftest fails, any mutant is not red-first or survives, `cellbest_control` mismatches the B0 receipt at any age, the manifest or any shard sha mismatches, denominators drift, any stored tree is touched, `dollar_line_reads` exceeds 1, or wall clock passes 3600 s. Report and wait. No dollar conclusion is drawn from a stopped run.

hg_projection.method: ceil(HG shards / 5 workers) times B0 same-store maximum shard seconds times a 2x five-line allowance

line_rules.cellbest_control: Recompute B0's positive-cash age-A cell-best ceiling line. Every per-age portfolio dollar block must be byte-equal to the B0 receipt.
line_rules.record_top1_all: Per gated cell, among READY age-A rows, enter the candidate with maximal r(X, A), ties smallest candidate_id, unconditionally. Cash is the entered row's cert_close_usd. The pick is blind to every cash column.
line_rules.record_top1_pos: Use the record_top1_all pick and enter only when maximal r(X, A) is strictly positive. Cells failing the clause remain in the denominator at zero cash.
line_rules.recordside_price: Restrict READY age-A rows to the stored side of the cell's maximal-r candidate, then enter the maximal-cert_close_usd row, ties smallest candidate_id. This decomposition cannot promote or witness.
line_rules.sideoracle_record: Restrict READY age-A rows to the stored side of the cell's age-A cell-best row, then enter the maximal-r candidate, ties smallest candidate_id. This decomposition cannot promote or witness.
